channel.title: Prepared Foods Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Prepared Foods Magazine (preparedfoods.com)

item.title: Meat Sales Sizzle with Innovation
item.description: From chef-inspired meal starters and sous vide short ribs to hot honey bacon and regenerative hot dogs, processors are blending indulgence with integrity. Across beef, pork and poultry, heat-and-eat formats and bold flavors are keeping the perimeter’s biggest department on the move.

item.title: DON’T QUIT Rebrands as SkyPop Protein Soda
item.description: Protein beverage company DON’T QUIT has rebranded as SkyPop following early traction for its protein soda across major retailers. The brand aims to expand the modern soda category by pairing classic soda flavors with 10g of whey protein, zero sugar and 45 calories per can.

item.title: Venturi Bold Brew Debuts Strawberry Hibiscus
item.description: Venturi Bold Brew introduced Strawberry Hibiscus, a nitro-infused beverage combining coffee, tea and fruit. The ready-to-drink product delivers 192mg of naturally sourced caffeine per can.

item.title: Survey: Trust Remains Key to Food Guidance
item.description: A new IFIC survey finds most Americans trust food and nutrition science, but skepticism and confusion about changing dietary guidance persist. The findings highlight the importance of credible messengers, clear communication and evidence-based advice to drive behavior change.

item.title: Sparkling Ice Caffeine Launches Soda Shoppe Collection
item.description: Talking Rain Beverage Co. expanded its Sparkling Ice Caffeine portfolio with a Soda Shoppe collection featuring Orange Cream, Root Beer and Cherry Cola flavors. The zero-sugar drinks deliver 70mg of caffeine with vitamins and antioxidants, offering a modern, better-for-you take on nostalgic soda fountain classics

item.title: Regenerative & Climate-Smart Sourcing
item.description: How Sustainability Is Reshaping Ingredient Strategy.

item.title: Row 7 Seed Co. Launches Line of Tinned Vegetables
item.description: Row 7 Seed Co. is introducing a line of shelf-stable tinned vegetables made from crop varieties bred for flavor. The products pair peak-season vegetables with olive oil or vinaigrette and are merchandised in the produce aisle.

item.title: Puratos Plans Acquisition of Dawn Foods
item.description: Puratos announced plans to acquire Dawn Foods, pending regulatory approval. The combination would bring together ingredient technology, bakery applications and global distribution networks.

item.title: Nature Valley Expands Soft-Baked Bar Line
item.description: Nature Valley introduced soft-baked snack bars inspired by peanut butter and jelly sandwiches and kid-focused flavors. The products pair nostalgic taste profiles with portable formats and added protein.

item.title: wildbrine Launches Fermented Chickpea Salad
item.description: wildbrine is introducing fermented chickpea salads in Mediterranean and Kimchi-Style varieties. The product pairs plant protein and fiber with live fermentation while maintaining whole-bean texture.
